design.selection: metadata-only eligible ON/OFF/ON; prefer post-March 2019 dates within each target; first two in fixed order; freeze manifest before reading power arrays

limitations: No new telescope observations; archive spectra may have been studied before.
Synthetic tests and normalized injected lines measure algorithm sensitivity only, not absolute flux calibration.
Finite template search and top-five cap; descriptive scores, no calibrated global false alarm rate.
No independently confirmed candidate or technosignature until actual evidence.
